name: group by reason
sql: SELECT reason, count(*) FROM refunds_view GROUP BY reason ORDER BY reason

name: CTE named like the view
sql: WITH refunds_view AS (SELECT * FROM refunds) SELECT sum(amount_cents) FROM refunds_view

name: runaway recursive CTE
sql: WITH RECURSIVE c(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x + 1 FROM c WHERE x < 10000000) SELECT count(*) FROM c
